architecture: OpenROAD write_pg_spice PDN (static R mesh) — frontend, not a PSM fork
replaceable extract layer (pdn_extract): SPICE + tech LEF; SPEF PG C from PG *D_NET; Grover on-die L (descriptor opt-in); dual-rail VSS sink-pair + opt-in instance C_rr + opt-in overlapping-strap Cox
replaceable activity (STA arrival t50 in clock mode, VCD/SAIF name-join, else synthetic) + current (triangle; CCS/ECSM interpolators when tables exist — never from NLDM)
Solver A: direct backward-Euler sparse LU (current_run) with R+L i_L history
Solver B: smoothed-aggregation AMG + CG on the SPD companion (workhorse)
Solver C: rational Krylov — RC on δv, or descriptor RLC on x=[v; i_L] matching i_L
Solver D: restricted additive Schwarz on the BE operator (graph partition, local LU, GMRES)
N4: native descriptor BE on Eẋ+Ax=u (VRM + bump R+L + die mesh); SparseLU, not AMG
EM: J=I/(w t) with w from RPERSQ·L/R; relative Black TTF; metal-graph thermal ΔT (straps+vias) + N1 R(T) + one-shot Solver A TRAN restamp (not gold); skin depth reported
Native BE/MOR/RAS/N4 in libdpn (Index=int64); Python orchestrates extraction and I(t); CCS lagged I(V) when tables+slew
V(x,y) heatmap at t_worst + OpenSTA path delay scaled by local Vmin (NLDM typical-V, not a second liberty)
not: CCS/ECSM I(t) on Nangate45 (NLDM, no current tables — interpolators are tested on synthetic Liberty)
gate-level VCD pin times (RTL VCD names do not match ODB ITerms — no silent map)
foundry Black TTF hours / extracted strap WIDTH from LEF geometry
3D thermal FEM / Si substrate CFD (lumped Si + ILD k_ox is not that)

roles.openroad: physical frontend — ODB → PDN graph; do not fork PSM
roles.extract: pdn_extract.write_pg_spice + tech LEF; SPEF PG C READY only when *CAP is stamped
roles.activity: pdn_activity: OpenSTA report_arrival t50 (clock); VCD/SAIF name-join only; windowed BE
roles.em: pdn_em: J from RPERSQ·L/R, relative Black TTF, metal-graph ΔT (straps+vias) → R(T) N1 + Solver A TRAN restamp — not foundry hours, not gold
roles.emsim: architectural split A (cell current → PWL) vs B (PDN TRAN) — not vendored, not run
roles.vyges_em_ir: bootstrap + simultaneous-switch validation — not the core
roles.this_engine: A DirectLU current_run + B SA-AMG + C descriptor RLC Krylov + D RAS + native N4 on write_pg_spice; triangle I(t) on NLDM
roles.ngspice: unit-test gold for BE on 1-node RC, 1-node series R+L, compact VRM+die, and 2-node C_rr / strap Cox
roles.xyce: GAP — future medium-scale gold, not the PDN-aware core

platform.name: hierarchical multi-fidelity power-integrity engine
platform.slice: native libdpn (A LU + B SA-AMG + C Krylov MOR + D RAS Schwarz + descriptor N4) + extract/EM layers + OpenROAD + triangle/CCS I(t)

native_index.via: libdpn Index = int64_t (Eigen StorageIndex + C API); SciPy fallback CSR may still be int32

do_not_implement_this_slice: silent RTL VCD → gate ITerm mapping (name-join only)

ml.role: scenario / window ranking only (MAVIREC, PowerNet, IR-Hunter)

gpu.idea: one LinearSolver API → CPU AMG / CPU Krylov / GPU AMG / GPU Krylov (Ginkgo)

tiny.scope: 1-node RC + 1-node series R+L companion + 2-node C_rr / strap Cox

medium.scope: parallel TRAN validation — not PDN-structure-aware core

C_rational_krylov_mor.role: multi-scenario reuse on the same PDN
C_rational_krylov_mor.killer_feature: one reduced ODE, many current waveforms

D_ras_schwarz.role: domain decomposition on the BE operator and on unsymmetric descriptor K
D_ras_schwarz.via: restricted additive Schwarz: undirected graph-grown subdomains, overlapping local SparseLU, RAS restriction, GMRES; kind=2 on descriptor K (never AMG)
D_ras_schwarz.not: index stripes, CG (RAS is not SPD), AMG

VSS_return.role: return-path TRAN on write_pg_spice VSS (block-diagonal default; C_rr / strap Cox opt-in)
VSS_return.not: replacement of VDD gold; C_rr and strap Cox are not GCD default

N3_RC_pkg.eq: RC + lumped package R+L companion at bumps
N3_RC_pkg.via: g_eq=1/(R+L/Δt) on pad diagonals; i_L history on the RHS
N3_RC_pkg.note: Grover partial self on 5701 straps (Σ 14.611 nH is not loop L; 11655 mutual pairs, d≤2 µm); default TRAN is still RC+pkg companion so AMG applies

N4_vrm.eq: on-die + package R+L + lumped VRM (descriptor BE)
N4_vrm.via: bumps as V sources in write_pg_spice; VRM ladder is system_pdn (not coupled TRAN)
N4_vrm.note: µs VRM capacitors look stiff on a sub-ns GCD window

FAST.this_slice: STA arrival t50 (622 ITerms) + Solver B SA-AMG

ACCURATE.intended: VCD/FSDB + CCS I(t) + AMG + adaptive timestep
ACCURATE.this_slice: adaptive BE with i_L history; CCS lagged I(slew,V^n) in Python TRAN when tables+slew; Nangate NLDM still GAP

SIGNOFF.intended: RLC + MOR/Krylov + direct spot checks + EM + package

em_thermal.model: I=(Va-Vb)/R; w=max(RPERSQ·L/R, WIDTH_min); J=I/(w·t); TTF_rel=(Jref/J)^2.0 at 358 K; ΔT from metal-graph G_th=kA/L (straps+vias) + ILD/Si + pad G_amb (lumped Rth comparison)
not: extracted strap width from LEF geometry (width from R, clamped to min WIDTH)
3D thermal FEM / package CFD (lumped Si + ILD is not that)
skin-effect stamp into G (reported, not restamped)

thermal_mesh.via: metal-graph G_th=kA/L + via HEIGHT/CUT + ILD k_ox A/HEIGHT to lumped Si (k_si A_die/t_wafer, t=300 µm); pad G_amb; not 3D FEM
thermal_mesh.note: Steady metal-graph ΔT; cell P=I_avg·Vdd at sinks + strap/via I²R. Via G_th from LEF HEIGHT/CUT. ILD k_ox A/HEIGHT to lumped Si (t_wafer=300 µm, not 3D FEM). Pad Rth=50 K/W C4-class. All heat exits G_amb; Si has no second ambient.

skin.via: wide-sheet t/min(t,δ); not Wheeler, not roughness, not PEEC
skin.note: Rac/Rdc≈1 — metal thinner than skin depth at this f

em_thermal.note: EM J from physics I(t) and LEF RPERSQ/thickness. metal-graph max ΔT=1.6796e-01 K (lumped isolation max 1.0396e-04 K).
em_thermal.rT_via: one-shot N1 restamp R'=R(1+αΔT) from metal-graph T (cell P=I_avg·Vdd + strap/via I²R; ILD→lumped Si; pad Rth=50 K/W); not 3D CFD

tech.via: tech LEF WIDTH/THICKNESS/HEIGHT/RPERSQ + CUT WIDTH/R — strap w from R, via G_th from HEIGHT/CUT

spef.via: SPEF PG *D_NET *CAP name-joined onto write_pg_spice nodes
spef.note: signal SPEF (no VDD/VSS *D_NET) — not PDN capacitance; lumped c_decap remains

on_die_l.via: Grover partial self-L + cutoff partial mutual on same-layer write_pg_spice straps
on_die_l.note: Σ partial self is not loop L (mesh paths are parallel). Partial mutual is same-layer parallel filaments with overlapping projection and d≤2 µm (spatial hash, k clamped to 0.99). No skin, no full PEEC. Vias stay resistive. Descriptor stamp is unsymmetric — not AMG. Default TRAN stays N3 RC+pkg companion unless --on-die-l.

extract.note: OpenROAD write_pg_spice R mesh; LEF for EM J; SPEF PG C is GAP (never mapped from signal nets); Grover on-die L on 5701 straps

B_pdn_solve.gold: ngspice 1-node RC + series R+L companion + compact VRM+die + 2-node C_rr/Cox; A vs B vs C vs D on the chip mesh
